tools.name: zenamu_list_classes
tools.description: List the published schedule of the studio for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, studio time zone, max 366 days). Returns classes and course sessions (read eventType), with times, lecturerIds, locationId, pricing options and seat capacity when requested. Canceled events are included with isCanceled=true. Zen

tools.name: zenamu_list_workshops
tools.description: List the studio's public workshops (standalone events such as retreats and intensives) for a date range (YYYY-MM-DD, max 366 days). Each workshop has its own address and pricing. Canceled workshops are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/workshops.

tools.name: zenamu_list_lecturers
tools.description: List the studio's lecturers with name, photo and bio. Use it to turn the lecturerIds from classes and workshops into names. Contact details are never returned. Zenamu API: GET /v1/lecturers.

tools.name: zenamu_list_places
tools.description: List the studio's physical locations with name and address. Use it to turn the locationId from classes into an address. Archived places are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/places.

tools.name: zenamu_list_clients
tools.description: List every active client of the studio with contact details, credit and entry-pass balances, pass balances per pass group, make-up sessions and booking totals. Returns personal data. Needs the secret key and the Ultimate plan. Archived and blocked clients are excluded. Zenamu API: GET /v1/clients.

tools.name: zenamu_list_pass_groups
tools.description: List the studio's entry-pass groups (active and archived) with their id, name and state. Use an id as passGroupId when granting passes. Needs the secret key and the Ultimate plan. Zenamu API: GET /v1/pass-groups.

tools.name: zenamu_grant_credits
tools.description: WRITE: adds credits to one client's account and returns the new balance. Changes what the client owes or holds. Not idempotent: a retry after an unclear failure can grant twice, so check the balance first with zenamu_list_clients. sendEmail=true emails the client. Zenamu API: POST /v1/clients/{clien

tools.name: zenamu_grant_passes
tools.description: WRITE: adds entry passes to one client's account in a pass group and returns the new balance in that group. Changes what the client holds. Not idempotent: a retry after an unclear failure can grant twice, so check the balance first with zenamu_list_clients. Omit passGroupId for the studio's default

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zenamu_grant_credits, zenamu_grant_passes · Private data: zenamu_list_lecturers, zenamu_list_clients, zenamu_list_pass_groups · Public sink: zenamu_grant_credits, zenamu_grant_passes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zenamu_grant_credits, zenamu_grant_passes · Private data: zenamu_list_lecturers, zenamu_list_clients, zenamu_list_pass_groups · Public sink: zenamu_grant_credits, zenamu_grant_passes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
